verdict.rationale: Agent-driven provisioning is a fair question for a FIDO hardware-key vendor, since vendors in this category can offer enterprise ordering and pre-registration APIs, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows human-operated tools (SK Manager, iePassManager, OTP Tool) and manual registration guides. There is nothing on ordering, assignment or pre-registration APIs, and the OpenAPI probe found no spec (all candidate paths returned 404).
